record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Topological Algebra
record.original_question: Under which conditions is the free universal algebra of an uncountable signature over a metrizable space X paracompact, and in particular, is the free topological linear space L(X) over X, taken over the discrete field of real numbers, paracompact?

evidence.quote: Problem 2 (Choban). Under which conditions is the free universal algebra of an uncountable signature over a metrizable space X paracompact? In particular, is the free topological linear space L(X) of X over the discrete field of real numbers paracompact?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a metrizable topological space. For a (possibly uncountable) signature Ω, the free universal Ω-algebra F_Ω(X) over X is the free Ω-algebra generated by X equipped with the finest topology making the inclusion X → F_Ω(X) continuous and all the operations of the signature continuous.

(a) Determine conditions on X (and on the signature Ω) under which F_Ω(X) is paracompact when |Ω| is uncountable.

(b) In particular, let ℝ_d denote the field of real numbers endowed with the discrete topology, and let L_d(X) denote the free topological linear (vector) space over X with scalars in ℝ_d, i.e. the topological ℝ_d-vector space with basis X carrying the finest vector-space topology making the inclusion X → L_d(X) continuous. Decide whether L_d(X) is paracompact for every metrizable space X.
